values.note: $15 a night for a single site (2026 and 2027 peak season, May 15 - September 30).

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/huron-manistee/recreation/rollways-campground (Fee Site and Info: 'Single Site: $15 per night'; last updated June 4, 2026) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233255/rates (Peak Season 2026-05-15 to 2026-09-30 and 2027-05-15 to 2027-09-30: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 15), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 19 sites, 18 of them pull-throughs taking 55 ft (one back-in, 30 ft). All roads and camping spurs are paved.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233255 ('The campground offers 19 pull-through campsites'; 'all roads and camping spurs are paved') + recreation.gov campsite catalog for 233255 (trip_data/ridb_campsites.json, fetched 2026-10-20) (19 STANDARD NONELECTRIC sites: Max Vehicle Length 55 x18, 30 x1; Driveway Entry Pull-Through x18, Back-in x1) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/huron-manistee/recreation/rollways-campground ('The pull-through campsites accommodate large motor homes and trailers'), read 2026-10-25

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/huron-manistee/recreation/rollways-campground (Restrooms: 'Vault toilet(s)'; Water: 'Potable water is available at this site.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233255 ('Vault toilets and drinking water spigots are dispersed throughout the campground'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 9 of the 19 sites are reservable on recreation.gov; the other 10 are first-come. 14 nights in a rolling 30 days. Run by the Forest Service; for late arrivals or early departures call Lumberman's Monument, 989-362-8961.

booking.source: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 233255 (trip_data/ridb_campsites.json, fetched 2026-10-20) (reservable: 9 sites true, 10 false) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233255 (facility_rules maxStay 14 nights 'Rolling 30 Days', maxConsecutiveStay 14, minConsecutiveStay 1 'soft'; notice 'For questions, late arrivals, or early departures please contact Lumberman's Monument at 989-362-8961'; is_commercially_managed false) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/huron-manistee/recreation/rollways-campground ('Make Reservations Here - Recreation.gov Reservations'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Interagency Senior and Access passes give 50% off single campsites only (the site the pass holder occupies).

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/huron-manistee/recreation/rollways-campground ('Interagency Senior and Access Recreation Passes provide a 50% discount to single campsites only'), read 2026-10-25

note: Huron NF near Hale, built in 1909 as one of the first Huron campgrounds, on a high bluff overlooking Loud Dam Pond on the AuSable River just off the River Road National Scenic Byway. Adjacent day-use area with a log shelter; an accessible trail runs to Westgate Scenic Overlook and passes a stairway down to the river. --Claude
summary: FS page (updated 2026-06-04, 'Site Open') + recreation.gov + RIDB catalog: $15 (confirmed, 2026 and 2027), 19 sites with pull-throughs (confirmed) to 55 ft (new), no electric (catalog, left), vault toilets and potable water, season May 3 - Sept 30, reservable on recreation.gov; fcfs changed after_cutoff -> some_sites (10 of 19 sites non-reservable); 14-night limit, senior/access 50%. Forest Service operated (not commercially managed). Phone (989) 739-0728 matches the FS page.
